title.zh: Arbitrum Security Council Takes Emergency Action to Transfer Binance-Related Sto
title.en: Arbitrum Security Council Takes Emergency Action to Transfer Binance-Related Sto

current_state.zh: The Arbitrum Security Council used emergency powers to transfer 74,559,805 ARB and 8,425 ETH tied to the Binance exploit from their original Arbitrum One address into an intermediary frozen wallet controlled by further council or DAO action.
current_state.en: The Arbitrum Security Council used emergency powers to transfer 74,559,805 ARB and 8,425 ETH tied to the Binance exploit from their original Arbitrum One address into an intermediary frozen wallet controlled by further council or DAO action.
